_readme: Non-secret settings for the API, like a small config server. Precedence: real environment variables (Vercel/shell) override this file. Pick the section by APP_ENV, else VERCEL_ENV (production|preview|development), else NODE_ENV. NEVER put passwords, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET or CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY here: the loader refuses them. Secrets live only in the host environment (see docs/deployment.md).
